title: A record's releases alone
description: data/releases/{owner}/{repo}.json beside data/mods/{owner}/{repo}.json: what a launcher picks a jar by, whether the repository is gone, the source a build is made from, and its releases without their notes, or each jar's scan, downloads, funding and icon, or each mod's name and description. A third of the record's size; the record has the rest. Fields may be added at any time.

gone.description: When the repository was found deleted or private

source.description: For a repository with no built release: the commit read and the mods its source declares

url.description: The author's own release download. Jars are never rehosted

sha256.description: The hash of the jar as read; verify the download against it

from.description: Where the link was read: funding (FUNDING.yml), readme, jar, modrinth

error.description: The jar could not be fetched or read; install nothing from it

gone.description: When the jar was found deleted from its release; it cannot be downloaded

replaced.description: Earlier jars seen under this asset before it was re-uploaded

knownBad.description: Why this jar is on the known-bad list. Never install it

loader.description: fabric, quilt, forge or neoforge, as the jar's own metadata says

description.description: As the jar declares it: a string, or a map of locale to string

minecraft.description: The game versions the jar declares, verbatim: a Fabric or Quilt range (alternatives joined by " || ") or a Forge or NeoForge Maven range. Absent when the jar declares none

version.description: The scanner version that read this jar; absent for one read before scanners were versioned

capabilities.description: Finding name (exec, classloading, native, network, unsafe; more may be added) to the evidence

additionalProperties.description: Class path (or nested-jar!class path) to the calls that showed the finding, each as owner.method, optionally followed by " in <method>"

signals.description: Warning name (webhook, session, persistence, clipboard, initializer, zip; more may be added) to the evidence

additionalProperties.description: Class path (or nested-jar!class path) to the calls that showed the finding, each as owner.method, optionally followed by " in <method>"

secrets.description: Store (such as discord or browser) to the evidence: code naming where other programs keep logins

additionalProperties.description: Class path (or nested-jar!class path) to the calls that showed the finding, each as owner.method, optionally followed by " in <method>"

hosts.description: Host named in the jar's strings to the classes naming it
